title: Benefits and Costs of Adaptive Sampling
abstract: arXiv:2604.24652v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Multi-armed bandits are widely used for sequential experimentation in clinical trials, public policy treatment, recommendation systems, and online platforms. While regret minimization and valid inference from adaptively collected data have each been studied individually, one question remains: when does adaptivity \emph{improve estimation precision} relative to uniform designs, and how should inference be balanced against the online cost of experimentation? We first study arm-level mean estimation under mean-squared-error (MSE) objectives. We characterize when an adaptive Neyman allocation, which allocates samples according to arm variance, yields strict MSE improvements over uniform sampling in finite samples. When there is variance heterogeneity across arms, these improvements arise at modest sample sizes, clarifying that adaptivity can be preferable for inference not only asymptotically, but also in finite-sample settings. translated_title: 自适应抽样的收益与成本
translated_abstract: 多臂老虎机被广泛应用于临床试验、公共政策干预、推荐系统和在线平台等序贯实验场景。尽管遗憾最小化与基于自适应收集数据的有效推断已分别得到研究，但仍有一个问题悬而未决：相对于均匀设计，自适应机制何时能提升估计精度？又应如何在统计推断与实验的在线成本之间取得平衡？我们首先在均方误差（MSE）目标下研究臂级均值估计问题，刻画了自适应Neyman分配（即根据各臂方差分配样本）在有限样本中何时能够相对均匀抽样带来严格的MSE改进。当各臂之间存在方差异质性时，这些改进在适度的样本量下即可出现，这澄清了自适应设计不仅在渐近意义下有利于推断，在有限样本场景中同样可能是更优的选择。
tldr: 本文刻画了自适应Neyman分配在有限样本中何时能严格改进均方误差，表明当各臂方差存在异质性时，自适应设计在适度样本量下即可优于均匀抽样，从而在提升估计精度与实验在线成本之间提供了权衡依据。
en_tdlr: This paper characterizes when adaptive Neyman allocation strictly improves mean-squared error over uniform sampling in finite samples, showing that under variance heterogeneity across arms, adaptivity can enhance estimation precision even at modest sample sizes, balancing inference benefits against the online cost of experimentation.
